items.subject: menu
items.title: Menu type-ahead exists only in vanilla
items.evidence: Only vanilla has type-ahead (vanilla/src/disclosures.ts:50-52 with normalizeSearch and a 500 ms buffer). React menu keydown handles only arrows/Home/End/Escape/Tab (react/src/expanded-interactive.tsx:42); Vue vue/src/expansion-interactive.ts:308-326; Angular angular/src/interactions.ts:52-56. No shared type-ahead helper in core (only normalizeSearch, core/src/index.ts:22).
items.remaining: Add a core type-ahead helper (buffer + match next enabled item by normalized label) and call it from React expanded-interactive.tsx:42, Vue expansion-interactive.ts:308-326, Angular interactions.ts:52-56; migrate vanilla disclosures.ts:50-52 to it. React labels are ReactNode, so the helper must read textContent of the item element.

items.subject: menu
items.title: Menu API differs in item shape, events, trigger, open control and markup across adapters
items.evidence: English 'Open' default removed: Angular triggerLabel is now required and warns (angular/src/interactions.ts:32, :45 texts.need). Rest unchanged: React MenuItem {value,label:ReactNode,disabled,href,onSelect}, onAction, open/defaultOpen/onOpenChange, no disabled (react/src/expanded-interactive.tsx:35-37); Vue MenuItem {value,label:string,disabled,href}, emits select, no open model, trigger text from `label` (vue/src/expansion-interactive.ts:223-237, :300); Angular HwMenuItem {id,label,disabled}, no href, (action) emits id, [(open)] but no defaultOpen, text-only trigger (angular/src/interactions.ts:44-58).
items.remaining: React (expanded-interactive.tsx:36-37): add disabled. Vue (expansion-interactive.ts:229-237): add open/defaultOpen/update:open and triggerLabel (see R24); align event name. Angular (interactions.ts:44-58): rename id->value (alias), add href items, trigger content projection, defaultOpen, align output name/payload. Decide one item shape and one event name for all four.

items.subject: popover
items.title: Popover closes when focus leaves only in vanilla
items.evidence: No framework popover has a focusout close: React listens to document pointerdown/keydown only (react/src/expanded-interactive.tsx:29-31); Vue only pointerdown + root Escape (vue/src/expansion-interactive.ts:163-189); Angular document:pointerdown and keydown.escape (angular/src/interactions.ts:40-41). Vanilla closes on focusout (vanilla/src/disclosures.ts:26). (Menus already close on focus leaving in React :42 onBlur and Vue :275.)
items.remaining: Add focusout (relatedTarget outside root -> close without focus restore) to React Popover expanded-interactive.tsx:29-31, Vue Popover expansion-interactive.ts:184-191, Angular HwPopoverComponent interactions.ts:40-41 (HostListener('focusout')); Angular HwMenuComponent inherits it.

items.subject: popover
items.title: React Popover closes on Escape pressed anywhere in the document and moves focus to its trigger
items.evidence: react/src/expanded-interactive.tsx:30-31: escape listener on ownerDocument, no root.contains(event.target) check; it closes and focuses the trigger. Angular checks host.contains (interactions.ts:41); Vue uses root onKeydown (vue/src/expansion-interactive.ts:184).
items.remaining: React expanded-interactive.tsx:30: check root.current?.contains(event.target) (or move the handler to the root onKeyDown) before closing and restoring focus.

items.subject: TreeView, ContentNavigation, Tabs, SearchField (root and field names)
items.title: Requiredness of the root name differs: React TreeView label is a plain required string; ContentNavigation label plain required in React, optional in Vue, required in Angular; Tabs missing label warns in Angular only; SearchField field name is a union in React and optional without warning in Vue and Angular.
items.evidence: Now uniform: Tabs label warns in all (react/src/interactive.tsx:68 text(), vue/src/interactive.ts:50 needText, Angular navigation.ts:26 texts.need); SearchField name warns in React (react/src/search-field.tsx:21), Vue (vue/src/search-field.ts:51) and Angular (angular/src/advanced-controls.ts:45); ContentNavigation warns via rootLabel in React/Vue (react/src/content-navigation.tsx:32, vue/src/content-navigation.ts:30) and is required in Angular (angular/src/content-navigation.ts:25). Remaining: React TreeView uses props['aria-label'] ?? label with no warning (react/src/expanded-interactive.tsx:98) while Vue uses rootLabel (vue/src/expansion-interactive.ts:592) with an optional prop (:519); declared requiredness still differs (React plain required, Vue optional, Angular required).
items.remaining: React expanded-interactive.tsx:98: use rootLabel('TreeView', props, label). Decide declared requiredness consistently (React union on aria-label/labelledby, Vue optional + warning, Angular required) and document it.

items.subject: PortalHeader, AppShell
items.title: React prop names navigation and brandHref where Vue and Angular use links and homeHref; React keeps wrappers div.hw-portal-header-main and div.hw-app-shell-body that Vue and Angular do not render.
items.evidence: React PortalHeader still uses navigation/brandHref (react/src/expanded-content.tsx:66-67) where Vue (vue/src/patterns.ts:84-85) and Angular (angular/src/content.ts:101-105) use links/homeHref; React still renders div.hw-portal-header-main (expanded-content.tsx:109) and AppShell div.hw-app-shell-body (react/src/expanded-layout.tsx:27), which Vue (vue/src/layout.ts:74-87) and Angular (angular/src/layouts.ts:76) do not.
items.remaining: React expanded-content.tsx:66-71: rename navigation->links and brandHref->homeHref (aliases for one release); decide whether hw-portal-header-main and hw-app-shell-body exist in all adapters (styles depend on them: dga.css:192, layout.css:123) and align Vue/Angular or React.

items.subject: SideNavigation and every landmark or group component
items.title: Owner decision: Angular forwards aria-label / aria-labelledby written on the host to the inner root, so a visible heading can name the component; today label is the only source in Angular.
items.evidence: Angular label remains the only name source: HwSideNavigationComponent host-binds [attr.aria-label] from texts.need('label', label) (angular/src/side-navigation.ts:11), so a host aria-labelledby cannot replace it without a missing-text warning; only the layout primitives preserve authored aria-label via HostAttributeToken (angular/src/layouts.ts:56-61).
items.remaining: Owner decision. If accepted: in Angular landmark/group components (side-navigation.ts:11 and the other texts.need('label') roots) read host aria-label/aria-labelledby (HostAttributeToken or attribute check) and skip label/warning when present, as React/Vue rootLabel do (react/src/shared.tsx:15-19, vue/src/shared.ts:58-62).
